normative_source.title: TurboQuant: Online Vector Quantization with Near-optimal Distortion Rate
normative_source.authors: Amir Zandieh, Majid Daliri, Majid Hadian, Vahab Mirrokni

decisions.summary: Derive portable uniform samples from domain-separated SHA-256 counter blocks and convert pairs with Box-Muller.
Use Householder QR and normalize every R diagonal to be non-negative.
Bind ordered finite centroids into profile configuration rather than making runtime numerical optimization part of decoding.
Encode sign values as positive for zero and positive inputs, and negative only for strictly negative inputs.
Pack coordinates in order, values most-significant-bit first, bytes in stream order, and require zero tail padding.
